nextTask.goal: Prove physical lane -> connector/direct handoff -> outgoing lane traversal with the same polyline sampler used by the materializer, without activating normal civilian traffic.
actions: Create a pure/isolated traversal harness that samples each current route stage with the existing materializer pointAlongPolyline implementation; do not add a second steering or sampling model.
Select representative production preferred transitions for straight, right, left and explicit dead-end U-turn movement.
Prove exact positional continuity at incoming lane end -> connector start and connector end -> outgoing lane start; direct handoffs must also be exact.
Prove sampled heading continuity is bounded by the compiler connector tangent contract.
Advance one stable token through representative crossings with leftover elapsed time and prove tokenId never changes.
Test connector and direct-handoff paths without mutating scene, materializer, pool, macro traffic or local topology.
Keep normal visible traffic on authored local lanes throughout M4.
acceptance: representative straight/right/left/u-turn production transitions are covered
position gap at every route-stage boundary is effectively zero
heading/tangent gap at connector boundaries stays within the compiler tolerance
same stable tokenId survives physical sampling across the junction
leftover elapsed time continues into the outgoing lane without a snap
harness reuses existing materializer lane sampling rather than free steering
doNotAdvanceIf: the harness requires free-form steering or a coordinate snap
any representative production transition has unexplained positional or heading discontinuity
a test can pass only by using macro district/node centres as physical coordinates
normal visible traffic begins consuming route cursor output before M5/M6 activation gates
